cli.root.short: Multi-provider web search and Markdown extraction (CLI, MCP, Agent Skill)
cli.root.long:
veri is a multi-provider web search and clean Markdown extraction tool for AI agents and developers.
Passing query arguments directly to the root command runs `veri search`.
cli.root.example:
veri key set deepseek
  veri "golang context cancellation"
  veri fetch https://go.dev/doc/effective_go --section "Concurrency"
  veri search "mcp sdk" -s github.com --json
  veri search "raft leader lease" -F --json
cli.help.more_search_flags: For advanced filter & fusion flags, run: veri search --help
cli.help.footer: Use "{cmd} <command> --help" for more information about a command.

cli.search.short: Search the web and return structured results
cli.search.example:
veri search "golang sync.Map" -n 5
  veri search "mcp protocol" -s github.com -t 3m --json
  veri search "llm benchmarks" -F -p exa,parallel,brave
  veri search "go concurrency" -p exa -o exa.category=news

cli.fetch.short: Fetch one or more URLs and extract main content as Markdown
cli.fetch.example:
veri fetch https://go.dev/doc/effective_go
  veri fetch https://go.dev/doc/effective_go --section "Concurrency"
  veri fetch https://go.dev/doc/effective_go -p exa,local
  veri fetch https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/go-sdk/blob/main/README.md
  veri search -q --format urls "golang mcp" | veri fetch -

cli.config.short: Manage veri configuration file and settings
cli.config.example:
veri config set providers.zhihu_web.search_db realtime
  veri config get providers.zhihu_web.search_db
  veri config unset providers.zhihu_web.search_db
  veri config show --overrides
  veri config init
cli.config.set.long:
Write a single option to config.toml while preserving existing comments; omitted options follow release defaults.
Plaintext api_key/token values are rejected; use `veri key set <provider>` or `env:VAR_NAME`.
cli.config.set.example:
veri config set providers.zhihu_web.search_db realtime
  veri config set search.count 10
  veri config set search.providers deepseek,zhihu_web,keenable
  veri config set search.providers_global ""

cli.config.get.short: Get the effective value of a configuration option
cli.config.get.example:

  veri config get search.providers --json
cli.config.get.flag.json: Output value and source as JSON
cli.config.unset.short: Remove a configuration option and restore default
cli.config.unset.example:

cli.key.set.short: Encrypt and store an API key (overwrites by default; -a appends)
cli.key.set.long:
Encrypt and store API key(s) for a provider (overwrites existing by default). Uses a hidden prompt interactively or reads from stdin when piped.
Separate multiple keys with commas; pass `-a/--append` to append and deduplicate without overwriting.
cli.key.set.example:
veri key set deepseek
  veri key set deepseek -a
  printf '%s' "$EXA_API_KEY" | veri key set exa
cli.key.set.flag.append: Append to existing keys and deduplicate instead of overwriting

cli.key.import.short: Batch encrypt and import API keys from config.toml or .env
cli.key.import.long:
Batch encrypt and store API keys into local secrets.json from config.toml, a .env file, or `-` (stdin).
With `--from-config`, plaintext keys are cleaned from config.toml after encryption (commented template sections revert to commented defaults), preserving other settings and `env:` references.
cli.key.import.example:
veri key import --from-config --dry-run
  veri key import --from-config
  veri key import .env
  cat .env | veri key import -
